remark: The `DateTimeParseException` can be thrown in the following scenarios not caught by the code: (1) In the TIMESTAMP case, when the value is a String that fails both ISO date-time parsing and long parsing, the third attempt `DATETIME_SPACE_FORMATTER.parse((String)value)` can throw; (2) In the DATE case, `LocalDate.parse((String)value)` can throw if the string is not a valid ISO local date; (3) In the DATETIME case, the second attempt `LocalDateTime.parse((String)value, DATETIME_SPACE_FORMATTER)` can throw if the string does not match the space-formatted pattern; (4) In the TIME case, `LocalTime.parse((String)value)` can throw if the string is not a valid ISO local time.
